required_coverage.population: US Compustat firms linked to the 28,142 firm-year paper sample, fiscal years 1997–2006
required_coverage.detail: The regressors use t and t−1 financial values; raw Compustat begins in fiscal 1996 at minimum. 1995 included as a conservative fiscal-year alignment buffer; ending sample year 2006.

requirements.description: Unstructured Item 7/Item 7a MD&A text from current and previous fiscal-year 10-K or 10-K405 filings; raw text must preserve fiscal-year label, filing date and CIK. SEC EDGAR route supplies the public filing; its index begins in 1994Q3.

required_coverage.frequency: annual 10-K/10-K405 filing text by filing calendar year
required_coverage.population: EDGAR public issuer 10-K filings for CIKs in the US Compustat cohort
required_coverage.detail: Fiscal-year labels are 1997–2006 plus prior FY1996–2005. Normal year-end filings occur after fiscal year end; non-December FY1996 filings may occur in calendar 1996. Use the outward raw filing-year envelope 1996–2007 and allow for late filing. Item 7/7a text and current-year word count are required.

routes.mapping_notes: Item 7 and Item 7a MD&A are extracted from unstructured 10-K and 10-K405 text. EDGAR indexes include CIK, form, date and filing path; extracting the section and removing tables remains construction work.
routes.coverage_notes: Paper fiscal-year labels run 1997–2006 and require prior fiscal-year MD&A labels 1996–2005. Normal year-end filings occur after fiscal year end, but some FY1996 filings may be calendar 1996 for non-December year ends; use outward raw filing-year envelope 1996–2007 and allow for late annual filings. CIK-to-GVKEY link requirement is separate.
